title: Report select control
responsibility: Provides a labeled native selection control with shared report styling.

inputs.name: Select.value
inputs.description: Optional bindable selected value, defaulting to an empty string.

inputs.name: Select.label
inputs.description: Required accessible label for the select.

inputs.name: Select.id
inputs.description: Optional HTML identifier. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting id.

inputs.name: Select.name
inputs.description: Optional form field name. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting name.

inputs.name: Select.required
inputs.description: Optional native required flag. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting the attribute; the browser does not require a selection.

inputs.name: Select.disabled
inputs.description: Optional disabled state, defaulting to false.

inputs.name: Select.compact
inputs.description: Optional compact size for dense navigation. Defaults to false; coarse-pointer targets remain larger.

inputs.name: Select.expanded
inputs.description: Optional in-page listbox mode, default false. True shows two to eight native rows including optgroup headings; longer lists scroll. The default mode is a native dropdown.

inputs.name: Select.display
inputs.description: Optional closed-field label. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, showing the native selection. Supplied labels over 16 characters show their first and last six characters; expanded mode shows complete native options instead.

inputs.name: Select.title
inputs.description: Optional hover text. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, falling back to the full display label when supplied; otherwise title is omitted.

inputs.name: Select.children
inputs.description: Required snippet supplying the option markup.

outputs.name: Select
outputs.description: A labelled native dropdown with a decorative caret, or an expanded in-page listbox with complete options. Binding updates its value; form, disabled and required semantics remain native. Expanded mode hides the closed-field display overlay and caret.

errors.name: Caller content or binding error
errors.description: Errors from the required option snippet or the caller binding setter propagate; the component does not catch them.
